[C]
I

[Verse 1]
left my home in Nor-
folk, Virginia, Cali-
fornia on my mind.
[F]I
[G]straddled that Greyhound and rode
him into Raleigh and on
across Caroline.
[C]We
stopped in Charlotte, but by-
passed Rock Hill, we
never was a minute late.
[F]A, we was
[G]ninety miles out of Atlan-
ta by sundown, rol-
lin' out of Georgia
[C]State. We
had motor trouble that turned
into a struggle half
way across Alabam',
[F]And that 'Hound
[G]broke down and left
us all stranded in
downtown Birmingham.
[C]

[Solo]
[C]
[F]
[G]
[C]

[Verse 2]
[C]Right away I bought me a through
train ticket, ridin'
'cross Mississippi clean.
[F]And I was
[G]on that Midnight Fly-
er out of Birmingham
smokin' into New Orleans.
[C]
Somebody help me get out
of Lou'siana, just
help me get to Houston town.
[F]There are a
[G]people there who care
a little 'bout me and they
won't let the poor boy down.
[C]
Sure as you're born, they bought
me a silk suit, and
put luggage in my hand.
[F]And I
[G]woke up high over
Albuquerque on a
jet to the Promised Land.
[C]

[Solo]
[C]
[F]
[G]
[C]A

[Verse 3]
[C]workin' on a Tbone steak
a la carte, flyin'
over to the Golden State,
[F]A when the
[G]pilot told us in
thirteen minutes he would
set us at the terminal gate.
[C]
Swing low, chariot, come
down easy,
taxi to the terminal zone.
[F]
[G]Cut your engines and cool
your wings and let me
make it to the telephone.
[C]
Los Angeles, give me Nor-
folk, Virginia Tide-
water fourteen o nine.
[F]Tell the
[G]folks back home this is the
Promised Land callin' and the
poor boy's on the line.
[C]
